A_selection: Choose lowest fixed-equal-pair A MAE among eligible completed approved pilots; at most one new candidate goes to C
C_group: Reuse exact previously recorded grouped C fit/validation breath IDs; C is resampling confirmation
C_training: Fresh candidate on C_fit only with its own training-only statistics; fixed A-selected best epoch and learning-rate prefix; no C feedback
C_unchanged_partner: Reuse hash-verified existing deep BiLSTM C predictions; fixed weights .5/.5
final_if_confirmed: Fresh compact candidate fit on all 67905 approved breaths for A-selected duration and rate prefix; combine .5/.5 with hash-verified unchanged deep all-data member
